segments.en: Otzar HaYirah — Treasury of Awe | Volume IV (נ–ת)

"I said to Hashem: You are my G-d — my good is not upon You. As for the holy ones who are in the earth — and the mighty — all my desire is in them. Boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places — indeed my portion is beautiful to me."
Completed and finished — praise to the G-d Creator of the world.
Otzar HaYirah — Volume IV (נ–ת) | 25 Chapters | Translation completed with reverence and joy
